subtitle: Closing the "whoever happened to be on call" gap, for real

code:
function Send-OverlookAlert {
    param([string]$Subject, [string]$Body)
    Send-MailMessage `
        -From "dba-alerts@overlookmedical.com" `
        -To "oncall-dba@overlookmedical.com" `
        -SmtpServer "smtp.overlookmedical.com" `
        -Subject "Overlook DB Alert: $Subject" -Body $Body
}
caption: A failed condition triggers a message automatically — no manual check required first.
The on-call DBA finds out within one scheduling interval — automatically.
